articles.headline: England's Jude Bellingham not confrontational with Ghana's Jordan Ayew - sources
articles.description: Jude Bellingham avoided a red card for covering his mouth in a verbal confrontation with Jordan Ayew during England's goalless draw with Ghana because it was "not in a confrontational manner," sources have told ESPN.

articles.headline: World Cup 2026 - updates, news as Ghana hold England, Bafana brace for South Korea
articles.description: Ghana held England to a 0-0 draw on Tuesday, but Congo DR lost 1-0 to Colombia. South Africa will likely need a win on Wednesday against South Korea to advance.

articles.description: With two goals in two games, Folarin Balogun is among the leading scorers at this World Cup, drawing interest from some of Europe's biggest clubs.
